detail.longDescription: The weekly reset has somehow become another productivity performance: clear every inbox, review every goal and plan every hour. We prefer a smaller version. Clear one loose end. Choose Monday’s first task. Put one worry somewhere safe. Then stop. Here’s a weekly reset for people who don’t want to spend Sunday organising Monday: https:// picnicapps.uk/blog/a-weekly-re set-for-people-who-hate-weekly-resets # Productivity # WeeklyReset # Wellbeing
